author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mobile-flutter
title: Cross-platform app with Flutter
description: Flutter with the official CLI: one Dart codebase for iOS, Android and web, with hot reload, widget tests and the Flutter team's architecture guides.

base.command: command -v flutter >/dev/null || { echo 'Flutter is required: https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/install' >&2; exit 1; }; flutter create {{name}} --org com.example --platforms ios,android,web --empty

instructions:
## How to work here

- Keep the UI (widgets in `lib/ui/`) apart from the logic (ViewModels) and the data (repositories and services in `lib/data/`), as Flutter's architecture guide recommends.
- Small widgets, `const` whenever possible; no business logic inside `build()`.
- Add packages with `flutter pub add`.
- Before finishing: `flutter analyze && flutter test`.
